facts.fact: Bayobab Uganda (MTN Group subsidiary) launched on 6 May 2025 a 260 km fibre route along the Uganda Railway line from Kampala to Malaba on the Kenyan border, built December 2024 to February 2025, which Bayobab says completes the Kampala-Mombasa backbone and carries over 1 Tbit/s.

systems.owner: Bayobab Uganda (MTN Group), built with Uganda Railway
